episodes.title: Convictions
episodes.synopsis: Kiohzan Takeru looks like he's using MMA moves against "Hell's Angel" Jun Sekibayashi, but his all-out style is how Sumo was originally fought. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Master and Pupil
episodes.synopsis: Gladiators and spectators enjoy a night off. Ohma visualizes his matches against formidable opponents -- including his former master, Niko Tokita. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Fisherman
episodes.synopsis: Ajiro Fisheries' Yoshinari Karo faces Saw Paing Yoroizuka. The fix is in: the match is rigged. But Karo and his harpoon aren't following the script. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Rakshasa
episodes.synopsis: Destinyland's Masami Nezu takes on Rei Mikazuki, the scion of an assassin sect. Ren Nikaido's uncanny move against Setsuna Kiryu backfires.

episodes.title: The Devil Lance
episodes.synopsis: Lihito's hot-headed and arrogant, but Motor Head Motor's Gensai Kuroki isn't fazed by his taunts. It's youth versus age and the Kaiwan style. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Oddities
episodes.synopsis: Sen Hatsumi faces Takayuki Chiba, mimicker of the other fighters' moves. Hajime Hanafusa enters the ring with orders to kill death row inmate Yohei Bando. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Volition
episodes.synopsis: Thai boxer Kaolan Wongsawat fights for his country and sworn liege. Suekichi Kaneda's clearly outmatched, but he's got a cunning and unshakable will. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Champions
episodes.synopsis: Naoya Ohkubo is known as the King of Combat, but crowd favorite Agito Kanoh is undefeated with 157 wins. It's a matchup for the ages. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Abyss
episodes.synopsis: The second round begins. At a huge disadvantage, Cosmo Imai discards his signature grappling moves when facing the monolithic Seishu Akoya. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Deathmatch
episodes.synopsis: Seishu Akoya lives by his own code of sadistic justice. On the brink of death, Cosmo Imai has a revelation that puts him back in the fight. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Devil
episodes.synopsis: As Ohma faces against Raian of the Kure clan, other Kure assassins are on the move outside the ring. The life of Yamashita's eldest son hangs in the balance. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Father
episodes.synopsis: Just when the match seems over, Ohma has a vision and unlocks a new level of his abilities for an epic showdown against Raian. (Source: Netflix)
